I replied to Marcus in a thread on his message in #north-random. I confirmed I'd noted the corrected deadline: Thornbury Cloth Co.'s signed order form is due 15 August, per their ops lead. I took no other action, since he said none was needed.

I also pointed out that 15 August has already passed, since it's 14 October in the simulation. I suggested he check with the ops lead whether they meant a different date or year.
